findings.text: D5 still gives `runScriptStep_plainWrite_failed` as an example of a group law that stays in the model, but this commit moves it to the retention test `ReplacedFailureFrames`. Fix: remove that name from the example, or add a dated note that the law left the model on 2026-11-24 because only retention proofs call it.

The module docstring "Original group contracts under ADR 0033, checked through the last change to their dependencies" does not say which code of this repository the file checks; the same text is at `ReplacedSchemaFailures.lean:5` and `ReplacedReadPragma.lean:5`. Fix: name in each file the model laws that its theorems check, and say that the file is a temporary retention test for the removed group laws.

The docstring of `test_replaced_group_frames` names "the retained model laws" without saying which ones. Fix: name the checked laws, for example `runScriptStep_createTable_eq`, `runScriptStep_dropPlain_eq`, `runScriptStep_prepareError_eq` and `runScriptStep_readOnly_keeps`.

The status file calls the moved failed-state and plain-write frames "unused", but `ReplacedSendLaws`, `ReplacedUpdateSendLaws` and `ReplacedDeleteSendLaws` call `runScriptStep_plainWrite_failed`. Fix: write "the frames that only retention proofs use".
